ee.title: Energy measures
ee.emptyReadOnly: Nothing has been proposed for this building yet.
ee.emptyHint: Add candidate energy-saving measures below, then mark the ones you're proposing for implementation — their standardized savings are computed from this building's envelope, systems, and (for lighting/equipment) before/after data on the Systems tab.
ee.name: Name
ee.investmentInvalid: Investment cost must be a non-negative number.
ee.lifetimeInvalid: Lifetime must be a whole number of years greater than 0.
ee.maintenanceInvalid: Maintenance cost must be a non-negative number, for example 0.01.
ee.targetsHint: If nothing is selected the whole category is counted (several measures in one category risk double counting).
ee.targetsEmpty: No matching type in the current state — enter it on the Envelope tab first.

ancillary.title: Ancillary costs (non-energy-saving)
ancillary.description: Renovation work required alongside the measures above but not itself energy-saving (e.g. cable replacement, re-plastering after insulation, pipe demolition) — counted toward total project investment, not toward energy/CO2 savings.
ancillary.unitCostInvalid: Unit cost must be a non-negative number.
ancillary.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be a positive number.

financial.title: Financial parameters
financial.description: Discount rate, price escalation and energy tariffs used for NPV, IRR and payback. Rates are real (before inflation); nominal values are derived below.
financial.descriptionReadOnly: Financial assumptions used for this building's calculations (view only).
financial.pvExportHint: Count exported PV electricity as income

derived.title: Derived values (read-only)
derived.hint: Calculated from the saved parameters; recalculated after saving.

financial.invalidFields: Some fields are empty or invalid — fix the highlighted fields and save again.
financial.fieldInvalid: Enter a valid value in the allowed range
